channelsSettings.needToken: Save a gateway token to edit channel settings.
channelsSettings.subtitle: Telegram, Weixin, and Feishu inbound channels. Changes are written to the gateway config file.
channelsSettings.connectionRunningHint: This channel is receiving and processing messages.
channelsSettings.connectionDisabledHint: Enable this channel to start receiving messages.
channelsSettings.connectionNeedsSetupHint: Finish connecting an account before this channel can start.
channelsSettings.connectionStoppedHint: This channel is not currently running. Restart it to resume receiving messages.
channelsSettings.selectChannel: Select a channel to configure it.
channelsSettings.scanLoginHint: Scan the QR code below with {{channel}} to finish connecting.
channelsSettings.cardSetupQrHint: Sign in or scan a QR code to let xopc receive and reply to messages from this channel.
channelsSettings.cardSetupConfigHint: Add the required credentials, then enable the channel when you are ready to receive messages.
channelsSettings.cardSetupGenericHint: Finish setup to route messages from this channel into your agents.
channelsSettings.basicConfigurationHint: Set the fields required for this channel to start and receive messages.
channelsSettings.agentRoutingHint: Route all incoming messages from this channel to an agent. More specific account or conversation rules can override it.
channelsSettings.messageHandlingHint: Use the default agent unless this channel needs its own routing rule.
channelsSettings.setupReadinessEnabledBody: This channel is enabled, but it is missing required setup. It will not work until these items are completed.
channelsSettings.setupReadinessDisabledBody: Complete these items before enabling this channel.
channelsSettings.setupIssueTelegramMissingCredential: Add a Telegram Bot Token or token file for at least one enabled account.
channelsSettings.setupIssueWeixinMissingAccount: Log in to Weixin and create at least one enabled account.
channelsSettings.setupIssueFeishuMissingCredentials: Add App ID and App Secret credentials.
channelsSettings.enableBlockedMessage: {{channel}} needs setup before it can be enabled.
channelsSettings.setupConfiguredHint: Channel config exists. Use actions below to reconnect or verify it.
channelsSettings.setupEmptyHint: Use the fastest setup path for this channel.

voiceSettings.needToken: Save a gateway token to edit voice settings.
voiceSettings.subtitle: Speech-to-text and text-to-speech for channels. Keys can also be set via environment variables.
voiceSettings.apiKeyMaskedHelp: Saved keys are hidden. Click the eye to load the key from your config file (not from environment variables).
voiceSettings.apiKeyNotInConfigFile: No key stored in the config file for this provider (check environment variables).
voiceSettings.apiKeyRevealFailed: Could not load key from config.

overview.title: Voice status
overview.description: A quick check of what the assistant can hear and speak right now.

language.title: Voice language
language.autoDescription: STT language and the built-in Edge voice follow the app language automatically.
language.manualDescription: App language changes will not overwrite the model language or selected voice.

behavior.title: How voice should work
behavior.description: Choose the user-facing behavior first. Engine details stay below.

text.title: Text only
text.description: No voice input or spoken replies.

listen.title: Listen to my voice
listen.description: Transcribe voice input, but reply in text.

conversation.title: Speak replies when I speak
conversation.description: Voice in, voice out. Best default for chat channels.

inputEngine.title: Voice input engine
inputEngine.description: Provider, model, API key, and fallback for transcription.

stt.title: Voice input (STT)
stt.description: Transcribe voice messages so the assistant can read them.
stt.enableDesc: When on, voice messages can be transcribed for the agent.
stt.apiKeyDesc: Optional if the key is already in the environment.
stt.fallbackDesc: Try the other provider if the primary request fails.
stt.refinementDesc: Optional model pass after transcription. Off avoids extra latency and model usage.
stt.localModelsDesc: Only model files are downloaded. Recognition runs privately inside xopc.

tts.title: Assistant voice replies (TTS)
tts.description: Generate audio when the assistant should speak back.
tts.enableDesc: When on, assistant replies can be spoken according to the rule below.
tts.triggerDescAlways: Apply TTS to all assistant messages.
tts.triggerDescInbound: Only reply with voice when the user sends voice.
tts.triggerDescTagged: Only when the [[tts]] directive is used.
tts.triggerHelp: Choose when assistant text should be converted to speech.
tts.alwaysWarning: Always-on voice can be noisy in busy chats. Use it only when the channel is meant to be audio-first.
tts.statusOff: Voice replies are off. Text replies are unchanged.

advanced.title: Engine setup
advanced.description: API key, model, voice, and provider-specific options.

providerHints.edge: Free and quick for setup; best for testing or casual use.
providerHints.openai: Low latency and broad voice selection; requires an OpenAI key.
providerHints.alibaba: Strong Chinese voices through DashScope; requires DASHSCOPE_API_KEY.
providerHints.minimax: High quality voices; async generation can be slower.
providerHints.localCli: Private local synthesis through Piper, sherpa-onnx, mlx-audio, or your own script.
providerHints.generic: Extension speech provider. Configure the required fields below.

test.title: Test voice
test.description: Generate a short sample with the selected provider, model, and voice before saving it for chats.
test.sampleText: Hi, I can read assistant replies aloud when voice output is enabled.

tts.edgeHint: Microsoft Edge TTS — no API key required.

localCli.presetDesc: Starts from a safe template for Piper, sherpa-onnx, or mlx-audio. Replace paths before testing.
localCli.cwdDesc: Optional. Defaults to the gateway working directory.
localCli.outputFormatDesc: File extension produced by the CLI (mp3, wav, opus, …).
localCli.timeoutMsDesc: Per-call timeout override; leave blank to inherit the TTS default.
localCli.hint: Provided by the bundled `tts-local-cli` extension. Enable the extension and configure the binary on PATH.

notes.title: Note
notes.duration: Long audio is split automatically; quality depends on provider and model.
notes.envVars: Environment variables: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY (when not set in this form).

gatewaySettings.needToken: Save a gateway token to load and edit gateway options.
gatewaySettings.subtitle: HTTP API access token and listen address. Values are stored in the gateway config file.
gatewaySettings.networkTabHint: Configure listen address, port, and allowed CORS origins.
gatewaySettings.accessTabHint: Configure token, password, trusted proxy, and failed-auth rate limiting.
gatewaySettings.updatesTabHint: Configure release channel, startup checks, and automatic update policy.
gatewaySettings.tokenExpired: Your session token was rejected. Update the client token or fix the access token in config.
gatewaySettings.tokenPlaceholder: Token stored in config (optional if using env)
gatewaySettings.tokenHelp: Used to authenticate HTTP/WebSocket API requests. You can also set XOPC_GATEWAY_TOKEN.
gatewaySettings.listenHint: Bind mode controls which network interfaces the gateway listens on. Auto: binds to 0.0.0.0 inside containers, 127.0.0.1 on host machines. Use LAN only with authentication enabled. Restart after saving.
gatewaySettings.restartHint: Changes to listen address, authentication, or process-bound security settings require a gateway restart.
gatewaySettings.restartGatewayConfirm: Restarting the gateway will interrupt all active connections. Continue?
gatewaySettings.authModeNone: Auth mode is set to none — API requests are not authenticated.
gatewaySettings.authModeTrustedProxyHint: Reverse proxy handles login and forwards user identity headers. Configure trusted proxy CIDRs and headers below. Restart after saving.
gatewaySettings.authPasswordPlaceholder: Password stored in config (optional if using env)
gatewaySettings.authPasswordHelp: Used when auth mode is password. You can also set XOPC_GATEWAY_PASSWORD.
gatewaySettings.rateLimitHint: Limits repeated failed auth attempts per client IP.
gatewaySettings.updateChannelHint: Beta and dev receive builds earlier; stable is recommended for daily use.
gatewaySettings.updateAutoSectionHint: Controls npm/CLI update checks on gateway start and background auto-update scheduling.
gatewaySettings.updateCheckOnStartHint: When enabled, the gateway checks for newer packages when it starts.
gatewaySettings.updateAutoEnabledHint: When enabled, eligible stable/beta builds may be applied automatically after the delay below.
gatewaySettings.updateAutoStableDelayHoursHint: Minimum hours after a stable release before auto-update may run.
gatewaySettings.updateAutoStableJitterHoursHint: Random extra wait up to this many hours to spread update load.
gatewaySettings.updateAutoBetaCheckIntervalHoursHint: How often to poll for beta builds when on the beta channel.
gatewaySettings.corsOriginsHint: Exact browser origins (scheme + host + port), e.g. http://localhost:5173. Changes apply immediately.
gatewaySettings.corsOriginsEmpty: No custom origins — gateway uses its own loopback, development, and detected LAN origins.
gatewaySettings.corsOriginsWildcardWarning: Wildcard "*" allows any website to call the API from a browser. Use only if you understand the risk.
gatewaySettings.securitySectionHint: OpenClaw-aligned guards for LAN and reverse-proxy deployments. Restart after saving.
gatewaySettings.securityStrictHint: When enabled, network-accessible binds require explicit failed-auth rate limiting configuration.
gatewaySettings.dangerouslyAllowHostHeaderOriginFallback: Dangerous: treat the HTTP Host header as an allowed browser origin when not listed in CORS. Prefer explicit corsOrigins.
Host-header fallback weakens browser origin checks. Use only behind a trusted reverse proxy with strict Host validation.
gatewaySettings.trustedProxiesHint: IP addresses or CIDR ranges of reverse proxies allowed to terminate trusted-proxy auth (e.g. 127.0.0.1/32, 10.0.0.0/8). Required on network binds.
gatewaySettings.trustedProxiesPlaceholder: CIDR or IP and press Enter
gatewaySettings.allowRealIpFallbackHint: When X-Forwarded-For parsing fails, fall back to X-Real-IP. Default is fail-closed (disabled).
gatewaySettings.trustedProxyUserHeaderHint: HTTP header set by the reverse proxy with the authenticated user identity.
gatewaySettings.trustedProxyRequiredHeadersHint: Additional headers that must be present on every request (e.g. X-Proxy-Auth).
gatewaySettings.trustedProxyAllowUsersHint: When non-empty, only these user identities are accepted. Leave empty to allow any non-empty user header value.
gatewaySettings.trustedProxyAllowLoopbackHint: Accept trusted-proxy auth when the TCP connection comes from 127.0.0.1 (same-host reverse proxy).
gatewaySettings.validationErrorTrustedProxies: Trusted-proxy auth requires at least one trusted proxy CIDR on network binds.
gatewaySettings.validationErrorUserHeader: Trusted-proxy auth requires a user identity header name.
gatewaySettings.validationErrorCors: Network-accessible gateway requires CORS origins or Host-header fallback.
gatewaySettings.validationErrorCorsWildcard: CORS wildcard is not allowed on network binds.
gatewaySettings.validationErrorCustomBind: Custom bind mode requires a bind address.
gatewaySettings.securityAuditSubtitle: Live check of saved gateway configuration (same as xopc doctor --security).
gatewaySettings.securityAuditSavedConfigHint: Reflects the config file on disk. Save form changes and restart the gateway to update results.
gatewaySettings.securityAuditNoFindings: No structured findings; configuration passes gateway security guards.
gatewaySettings.advancedSectionHint: Runtime limits and channel startup ordering. Restart the gateway after saving.
gatewaySettings.channelConnectDeferModeHint: Controls when outbound-heavy channels call `start()` relative to HTTP listen. Auto defers plugins that opt in (e.g. Telegram, Weixin, Feishu).
gatewaySettings.channelConnectDeferIdsHint: Used when mode is Explicit. These plugin ids start after HTTP listen (max 24). Empty means defer none.
gatewaySettings.channelConnectDeferSkipIdsHint: Removed from the defer set after auto or explicit resolution (max 24). Example: keep Telegram on phase 1 but defer others.
gatewaySettings.channelIdListPlaceholder: Channel id and press Enter (e.g. telegram)

heartbeatSettings.needToken: Save a gateway token to load and edit heartbeat options.
heartbeatSettings.subtitle: Periodic agent wake, optional delivery to a channel, and HEARTBEAT.md under the default agent's profile directory. Stored in the gateway config file and agents/<id>/profile/.
heartbeatSettings.triggerHint: Queues one heartbeat run (same as the timer). Skipped if HEARTBEAT.md is empty, outside active hours, or heartbeat is disabled.
heartbeatSettings.unsavedDoc: You have unsaved changes to HEARTBEAT.md.
heartbeatSettings.scheduleTabHint: Control whether heartbeat runs, how often it runs, and active hours.
heartbeatSettings.deliveryTabHint: Choose the channel and conversation to deliver replies to; leave empty to only log them.
heartbeatSettings.promptTabHint: Tune the heartbeat system prompt, silent-reply threshold, and session isolation.
heartbeatSettings.documentTabHint: Maintain the tasks and reminders read on each heartbeat.
heartbeatSettings.docHint: Tasks and reminders read by the agent on each heartbeat. Leave empty or comment-only to skip LLM calls and save tokens.
heartbeatSettings.includeSystemPromptSection: Include heartbeat instructions in chat system prompt
heartbeatSettings.includeSystemPromptSectionHint: When off, heartbeat instructions are only sent during scheduled heartbeat turns (saves tokens in normal chat).
heartbeatSettings.intervalHint: Minimum 1 second. Saved to the gateway as milliseconds.
heartbeatSettings.intervalHintPreset: Quick preset or type seconds in the field.
heartbeatSettings.deliveryHint: Both channel and chat id are required to send non-silent replies somewhere. Otherwise the reply is only logged.
heartbeatSettings.promptHint: Leave empty to use the built-in default prompt.
heartbeatSettings.ackMaxChars: Max reply length before treating as silent (ackMaxChars)
heartbeatSettings.isolatedSession: Use a fresh session key each run
heartbeatSettings.isolatedSessionHint: Avoids mixing heartbeat context with the main chat session.
heartbeatSettings.activeHoursHint: Restrict heartbeats to this window. Clear to run any time.

webSearchSettings.title: Web search
webSearchSettings.subtitle: Configure region and search providers for the web_search tool. Without API keys, a built-in HTML fallback is used.
webSearchSettings.needToken: Save a gateway token to edit web search settings.
webSearchSettings.loadError: Failed to load web search settings
webSearchSettings.sectionRegionHint: Controls which zero-config HTML fallback is used when no API provider succeeds (China → Bing; otherwise DuckDuckGo).
webSearchSettings.sectionSearchHint: Providers are tried in order. Keys are stored in the gateway config file. Leave the list empty to use only the HTML fallback.
webSearchSettings.sectionBlocklistHint: When enabled, web_search and web_extract skip URLs whose host matches these domains (exact or suffix match).
webSearchSettings.blocklistEnabledDesc: Blocks matching hosts before fetch; useful for privacy or compliance.
webSearchSettings.blocklistDomainsDesc: One domain per line (e.g. example.com). Subdomains of listed domains are also blocked.
webSearchSettings.regionDesc: Auto uses your system timezone. Override if you are on a VPN or need a specific fallback.
webSearchSettings.maxResultsDesc: Used when the model does not pass a count (1–50).
webSearchSettings.apiKeyDesc: Optional for some setups. Leave masked to keep the saved value.
webSearchSettings.urlDesc: SearXNG base URL (e.g. http://localhost:8080). No trailing slash required.
webSearchSettings.keyPlaceholder: API key or env var name
webSearchSettings.footerHint: HTML fallbacks depend on third-party pages and may change. For production, use a supported search API (Brave, Tavily, Bing, or self-hosted SearXNG).
